description: Removes an existing subscription to SCP (local) Domain Information Change by DELETE on the individual subscription URI received in the Location header of the successful subscription response.

constraints.statement: The Service Consumer shall send a DELETE request to the resource URI representing the individual subscription.
evidence: "The Service Consumer (e.g. SCP or NRF) shall send a DELETE request to the resource URI representing the individual subscription."
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the required HTTP method and target resource for the unsubscribe API.

constraints.statement: The request body shall be empty.
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable request payload constraint.

constraints.statement: On success, the NRF shall return 204 No Content.
evidence: "On success, \"204 No Content\" shall be returned."
constraints.why_interesting: This specifies the required success status code.

constraints.statement: On success, the response body shall be empty.
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable response payload constraint on successful unsubscribe.

constraints.statement: On failure, the NRF shall return a 4xx or 5xx response.
evidence: "On failure, the NRF shall return \"4xx/5xx\" response"
constraints.why_interesting: This defines the allowed failure status code classes for the operation.

constraints.statement: On failure, the response body may contain a ProblemDetails object describing the detailed information of the failure.
evidence: "the response body may contain a ProblemDetails object describing the detailed information of the failure."
constraints.why_interesting: This identifies the optional error payload format that can be checked in negative tests.
